notes.title: Early Access Devlog - Week 3: Final Boss Fight & Controller Support
notes.content:
Watch the Devlog here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=89i9Eq41gRU

Controller support didn't come together like I'd hoped. The gameplay doesn't lend itself to a gamepad as much as I'd like it to. I'd best equate it to playing DOTA or League of Legends with a gamepad. It's just not viable.

Instead, I spent the week re-working the final boss fight to give it the difficulty it deserves.

notes.title: Rune Store!
notes.content:
The Rune Store is open and functional! 

While it may need some visual updates, I wanted to get the functionality in game ASAP to give players longer-term unlockables to work towards.

Runes can be bought and equipped prior to making a run, and once purchased, they will be available for subsequent playthroughs for all eternity.

They range from small damage bonuses, all the way up to unlocking every single skill for a class making him or her a killing machine.

They might make enemies drop more XP, or they might just make twice as many enemies spawn, but in a much weaker form so you can cause absolute mayhem.

Have fun!

notes.title: Early Access Devlog - Week 1: Runes and The Rune Store
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bn9E8FgROSo]Watch the Devlog Here![/url]

In the very first Devlog for Bragger's Run EA, I show the beginnings of a Rune Store, and the ability to buy and equip powerups using the new In-Game currency: Gems.

I'll continue with updates each week to showcase progress as I work towards making Bragger's Run a finished product.
